summary: Frontend-only validation of the batch changes on the public URL (?static=1). Verified: menu kicker label 'Menù' (IT) and EN/DE/FR variants; reservation area buttons with no capacity numbers and no hint line; contact events note with tel: landline + wa.me WhatsApp links; events CTA 'Vedi gli eventi' as a Link navigating to /eventi with 3 event posts and working back links; nav + mobile nav 'Eventi' routing to /eventi (react-router, no reload, scrollY 0) while 'Storia' -> /storia; homepage section order Storia -> Eventi -> Menu -> Contatti; regressions: reservation POST /api/reservations + WhatsApp popup to 393899074966, menu tabs cucina/pizza/vini (26/37/16 items), language switcher translating all 4 locales. All 4 locales verified for menu label, area labels, CTA text, nav label and events note phone/WhatsApp numbers. No console errors, no broken images on /eventi.

issues: Decorative circular scroll-progress indicator overlaps the header intro paragraph text, slightly reducing legibility (cosmetic, low priority)

critical_code_review_comments: Contatti.jsx eventsNote parsing relies on both {phone} and {whatsapp} placeholders existing in every locale; a missing placeholder would throw on split()[1]. Consider a safe token-replace helper.
Guest capacity is still enforced only via the native input max + a toast; the POST /api/reservations payload is not server-validated for capacity (not part of this batch, informational).
seed_data_creation: One reservation POST created with name 'TEST_QA' (2026-09-15, esterno) as part of regression testing.

Use ?static=1 to skip preloader. All batch changes verified passing in this iteration.
rca_of_the_issue: No product defects found; the only initial test failures were wrong test selectors, corrected in the test scripts.
